podcast.body: An acoustic EP featuring acoustic versions of songs from "High Noon," created in response to fan demand for recorded acoustic performances seen on YouTube. Tracks like "1111" and "My Heart's All Yours" from this EP are frequently used for first dances at weddings. The EP was partly a competitive effort to showcase that their songs, when played acoustically, could serve as effective "soothing music" for studying. "It was just a little acoustic thing that we did. That was, uh, acoustic songs from high new."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This EP is mentioned as a future topic for discussion in part two of the interview, described as "a strange little EP." "On part two, we'll cover the recording and release of the Michigan Left album, High Noon, a strange little EP called Study Music."
